Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points:
- 4 years of data science experience (only 3 years shown)
- Hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (Pyro, PyMC3, JAGS, or similar)
- Experience with Amazon SageMaker (cloud platform)
- Experience with PySpark
- Strong working knowledge of SQL

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
